meta.name: Player Gear
meta.about: What pickleball players use, keyed to the Paddle Register by paddle id. A pro's gear comes from the brand, a press release or a dated article. Anyone else's gear comes only from their own word.
rules: Every pro item carries a source and a date. Unknown stays unknown.
No rankings, ratings, ages, homes, photos, socials or contract amounts. Rankings and ratings are linked out to the official pages.
Players add or change their own gear; nobody else's word puts a non-pro's gear on file.
Corrections and removals are honored as soon as they are read.

gear.note: Same model listed by JOOLA's own Pro V launch (2026-03-03) and Team JOOLA roster; JOOLA also makes a Ben Johns Hyperion Pro V 16mm.
2025 product collaboration; not reconfirmed for 2026.

career.text: Turned pro in 2016.
Has won more than 80 PPA Tour titles, including 15 triple crowns.
First male pro to win a triple crown at a major, the 2019 Tournament of Champions.
With brother Collin Johns, formed the winningest men's doubles team in PPA Tour history (33 golds) before splitting ahead of 2025.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by Los Angeles Mad Drops for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.
Named to the Team USA roster for the 2026 MLP Nations Cup.

gear.note: The Dink (2026-08-30) reports the name may be 'Whip', unconfirmed. Earlier in 2026 she debuted her Franklin signature C45 Aurelius 12.7mm (The Kitchen, 2026-02-10); The Kitchen's April 2026 tracker listed a Franklin C45 Hybrid 14mm. Left Paddletek for a long-term Franklin deal in Jan 2026.
Nike is her official apparel and footwear partner; replaced Fila.
Forbes (2026-01-13) still lists Pilla among her partners.

career.text: Turned pro in 2019.
Had 202 PPA medals and 45 triple crowns as of October 2026.
Became the winningest player in PPA Tour history with her 168th title at the 2025 Pickleball World Championships.
First pickleball athlete signed by Nike to a multi-year deal; from Clinton, North Carolina.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by New Jersey 5s for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.

gear.note: JOOLA's Pro V launch (2026-03-03) ties the Kosmos 16mm to him; The Kitchen's signature list (2026-08-20) counts it as his signature. Rejoined JOOLA after leaving adidas Pickleball (2025).

career.text: Argentine former tennis player who began playing pickleball in July 2021.
In 2024 won nine singles and five men's doubles titles and medaled at all 24 PPA Tour events.
Won men's singles and men's doubles (with Hayden Patriquin) at the 2025 Pickleball World Championships.
Named Finals MVP as the New Jersey Fives won the 2026 MLP championship.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by Orlando Squeeze for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.

gear.note: Signature per JOOLA Pro V launch (2026-03-03); also on JOOLA's 2026 medals post (2026-05-22).
Signed Nov 2025; not reconfirmed in a 2026 source.

career.text: Cal Berkeley graduate who came to pickleball from junior tennis; an MLP champion.
Won 2025 Pickleball World Championships women's doubles gold with Anna Leigh Waters.
Won 2026 Mesa Cup mixed doubles with Hayden Patriquin, her 11th career gold, plus women's doubles with Waters.
She and Waters reached 21 gold medals together at the 2026 Greater Zion Cup.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Drafted by St. Louis Shock in the 2026 Major League Pickleball draft.
Named to the Team USA roster for the 2026 MLP Nations Cup.

gear.note: Not described as a signature model. Signed with Paddletek Group (which acquired PIKKL) on 2026-07-07 after his Franklin deal ended; Sep 2026 tracker had him on an unreleased PIKKL paddle; April 2026 tracker listed Franklin C45 Dynasty 16mm.

career.text: Won a triple crown at the 2022 APP Delray Beach Open.
Took 2025 Worlds silver in men's doubles (with CJ Klinger) and mixed (with sister Jorja Johnson).
Signed with Paddletek Group in July 2026 alongside Jorja Johnson.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by Dallas Flash for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.

gear.note: Franklin sells a Hayden Patriquin C45 series in 14mm and 16mm; The Kitchen's signature list (2026-08-20) counts it as his signature.
He helped develop the shoe per this Oct 2025 agency release; not reconfirmed in a 2026 source.

gear.model: Hayden Collection signature hat and tee
gear.note: 2025 capsule collection.

career.text: Won back-to-back Worlds men's doubles titles: 2024 with Riley Newman and 2025 with Federico Staksrud.
Won 2026 Mesa Cup mixed doubles with Anna Bright, his second mixed gold.
Played for the St. Louis Shock, runners-up in the 2026 MLP championship.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by St. Louis Shock for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.

gear.note: Paddletek's TKO-X release coverage (The Kitchen, 2026-05-12) names him among pros using it; thickness not stated. April 2026 tracker listed Bantam TKO-CX 12.7mm. With Paddletek since Feb 2024.

career.text: Went 18-0 and won a Division III national title in tennis at the University of Chicago.
Won his first PPA singles title at the 2025 Cape Coral Open.
Took 2025 Worlds men's doubles bronze with Andrei Daescu.
Reached the 2026 Mesa Cup and Greater Zion Cup men's doubles finals with Hayden Patriquin.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by Texas Ranchers for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.

gear.note: Signed with Facolos through 2027 (The Kitchen, 2026-01-13), which said he would use the EliteX and develop a co-branded collection; not described as a signature paddle. Previously PIKKL.
His signature shoe; deal announced April 2026.

career.text: Bolivian; won nine PPA Tour golds with Ben Johns in 2025.
Won 2026 Mesa Cup men's doubles with Ben Johns.
He and Johns won their 15th gold together, a seventh straight title, at the 2026 Greater Zion Cup.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.

gear.note: Sources differ on the shape variant: The Kitchen (2026-11-06, 2026-09-08) says CRBN1 TruFoam Barrage; CRBN's undated pro-team page says CRBN3 TruFoam Barrage (Elongated); April 2026 tracker said CRBN2. Played Proton in 2025.
Wikipedia lists Mizuno as a sponsor with no year or product category; not confirmed for 2026.

career.text: Romanian former ATP player who represented Romania in the Davis Cup and played the 2015 U.S. Open.
Found pickleball in 2017 and began playing tournaments in 2018.
Won the 2023 US Open men's doubles title and two MLP championships.
Took 2025 Worlds men's doubles bronze with Christian Alshon.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Kept by Columbus Sliders for the 2026 Major League Pickleball season.
Named to the Team Europe - East roster for the 2026 MLP Nations Cup.

gear.note: Team JOOLA roster page is undated. JOOLA's Pro V launch (2026-03-03) ties the Kosmos 14mm to him, and The Kitchen's signature list (2026-08-20) counts it as his signature. He was not in The Kitchen's Nov 2026 tracker.
Signed as a Skechers ambassador in 2022; SI (2025-02-20) still tied him to a Skechers Viper Court Pro shoe. Not reconfirmed in a 2026 source.

career.text: Picked in the first round of the first Major League Pickleball draft (2021).
Beat Ben Johns at the 2022 PPA Texas Open after several final losses to him.
Won the 2025 Australia Pickleball Open with Gabe Tardio.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.
Drafted by Palm Beach Royals in the 2026 Major League Pickleball draft.

gear.note: No dated Proton signing announcement found. She has moved around in 2026: Selkirk deal ran through February (The Dink); JOOLA Scorpeus Pro V 14mm in April (The Kitchen; JOOLA's 2026-05-22 post); Luzz Glider in September (The Kitchen, 2026-09-08).
Signed as a Skechers ambassador in 2022; Wikipedia lists Skechers as a sponsor as of Aug 2023. Not reconfirmed in a 2026 source.

career.text: Canadian from Montreal who played NCAA tennis at Arkansas and Michigan State.
Turned pro in 2016.
Three-time US Open champion with 16 PPA Tour titles, per Wikipedia.
Took 2025 Worlds women's doubles silver with Parris Todd.
Listed on Major League Pickleball's team pages.

gear.note: Not described as a signature model. Signed with Paddletek Group 2026-07-07 after her Franklin deal ended; Sep 2026 tracker had her on an unreleased PIKKL paddle.

gear.note: V2 launch set for 2026-08-23; individual V2 model names not given. First-generation models were the QD Air and QD Fire (World Pickleball Magazine, 2026-02-16, updated 2026-10-25). Left Sypik for Wika in Feb 2026. Not in The Kitchen's PPA trackers.

career.text: Won his first PPA Tour gold in men's singles at the 2024 Las Vegas event.
Signed a non-exclusive multi-year APP Tour deal in March 2026.

gear.note: Also on Team JOOLA roster (undated) and The Kitchen's signature list (2026-08-20). Not in The Kitchen's Nov 2026 tracker.

career.text: With brother Ben Johns, won 33 PPA men's doubles golds, the most by any team in tour history.
The brothers led the tour in men's doubles golds each year from 2021 to 2024, then split ahead of 2025.
